text: Durgura is an Orsimer residing at Scarp Keep in the city of Orsinium.
Dulfra is an Orsimer smith found sweeping the floors at Orzorga's Kitchen in the town of Morkuldin Haven.
Dulrat is an Orsimer weaponsmith in charge of the Morkul Metalworks together with armorer Skalguth in Morkul Stronghold, Wrothgar.
Durrinia is a Redguard laborer residing in Abah's Landing, Hew's Bane.
Duneracer is a creature that appears in . They are known to inhabit the region of Craglorn.
Dust-Foe is an Argonian working at the keep at Alcaire Castle.
Dulcilla Iullus is an Imperial soldier of the Imperial Legion. She is found in the Nobles District of the Imperial City.
Dushugg is an Orsimer priest of Trinimac found in the Temple of Ire in the city of Orsinium.
Dutadael is a Dunmer commoner residing in Ahemmusa Camp, in Vvardenfell. She has no unique dialogue.
Dusteater Brute is a generic Goblin Brute residing in locations . They are part of the Dusteater tribe of Goblins.
Dusk Scholar Charger is a generic Thundermaul residing in locations in .
Dummu is a Dunmer commoner and Ashlander residing in the Erabenimsun Camp in Vvardenfell. She has no unique dialogue.
Dulgiijbiddiggungudingu, better known as Dulg, is a character that appears in and . He works for chef Toel.
Dusteater Butcher is a goblin in that is a member of the Dusteater Tribe.
Dusteater Ranger is a goblin in that is a member of the Dusteater Tribe.
Dusteater Shaman is a goblin in that is a member of the Dusteater Tribe.
Dusteater Firestick is a goblin in that is a member of the Dusteater Tribe.
Dus-Geet is an Argonian residing in a camp east of Hissmir. She is a target of the Blackguards because of her information concerning Margus Derius.
Duzhargo is a Khajiit musician playing an instrument and singing in The Sugar Bowl in the city of Rimmen, Northern Elsweyr. He has no unique dialogue.
Durash is an Orsimer residing on the northern shore of Lake Rumare in Cyrodiil.

Dylora is a Dark Seducer who served Sheogorath, and was commander of her kin in the Daedric Forces of Madness. During the Fourth Era Greymarch, she led the Mazken in their fortress of Pinnacle Rock in the Shivering Isles. Over the course of the Greymarch, an attack was launched on one of the strongholds of Madness. This stronghold may or may not have been Pinnacle Rock. If so, then Dylora led the Dark Seducers in defending their base after they were tricked by the traitor duke Syl, who let the Forces of Order enter. Eventually, Order would succeed in taking the base, and Dylora was captured.

Earana is an Altmer and nemesis of Mages Guild member, Teekeeus. She seeks arcane knowledge locked in the book Fingers of the Mountain, knowledge that is forbidden by the Mages Guild. Because of this, she wants to prevent Teekeeus from securing the book. She stays at The Grey Mare tavern in Chorrol, but can often be found near the front of the Chorrol Mages Guild near the large oak tree. Earana wears upper class clothing and has a cold and snooty personality. She is a wealthy woman that will stop at nothing to get what she wants.
Dyus, also known as Dyus of Mytheria, is an Imperial crusader who will help the Hero of Kvatch assume the Throne of Madness in the quest "Symbols of Office."
Earmil is an Altmer witchhunter and worshipper of Mehrunes Dagon residing in shrine Assurnabitashpi. He is hostile and attacks the Nerevarine on sight.
Dzeizik is a Goblin of the Toothmaul Tribe. Killing him counts towards the "Toothmaul Gully Conqueror" and the "Toothmaul Gully Vanquisher" achievements.
Earanyon is an Altmer armorer residing in Woodhearth, Greenshade. He can be found selling his wares at Maiden's Guard.
Earnaana is a Altmer enchanter residing in Elden Root, Grahtwood, and is a member of the Mages Guild.
Eancar is an Altmer commoner residing in The Middens, Elden Root.
Dylyn Belavel is a Dunmer mystic and a member of the Mages Guild. He is found at their branch in the Redfur Trading Post.
Dylyn the Meek is a Dunmer and the innkeeper of The Watch House in Davon's Watch.
Ealare is an Altmer residing in Khenarthi's Roost in the port city of Mistral.

Earrona Kneecapper is an Altmer Mystic and member of the Undaunted found drinking with her companions in Velyn Harbor, later found encamped within the Hel Ra Citadel at the entrance, along with her fellow comrades, Sleeps-on-Shield and Kailstig the Axe.
Dyleso is a Dunmer member of the Fighters Guild. He is the hall steward of their branch in Kragenmoor.
Eardir is an Altmer in who resides in the city of Skywatch. He can be overheard talking with Linyon near the Docks.
Eager-to-Leave is an Argonian commoner residing in Nimalten. He can be found in the Common Hall.
Ealonwe is an Altmer magus of the Mages Guild found in the hall of Dune.
Eanor is an Altmer clothier and member of the Aldmeri Dominion residing at the Eastern Elsweyr Gate. He can be found at the Armory Merchants, selling his wares.
Eager-Teeth is a tame Guar found in the Argonian settlement of The Gray Mire in Grahtwood, where she is first encountered standing next to No-Fingers, chewing on the corpse of a fallen hunter.
Earamon is an Altmer Noble found in Rawl'kha. He can be found watching Finedrin in the stocks.
Earelcar is a member of House Montclair's forces part of the trio leading the excavations in the ruins of Erokii.
Earos is a soldier of the Aldmeri Dominion guarding the southeast gate of Firsthold.
The East Empire Dockmaster is the dockmaster in charge of East Empire Company Warehouse in Solitude. He can be found in the Dockmaster's Office.

Earila Faryon is a Dunmer woman residing in Quarantine Serk. She can be overheard conversing with Furil Faryon, who has traveled here seeking the cure for the Llodos Plague. They are indirectly involved in the "Bad Medicine" quest, as a result.
The Earthen Heart Knight is a Dunmer warrior of House Dres. He serves as the boss of the fourth round at the Dragonstar Arena.

Dyzera is a female Daedra found within her pocket realm accessed from Cold-Blood Cavern, Shadowfen, in . She has been behind the abductions of Azura's oracles, and is implied to be acting on behalf of a Daedric Prince.
Ealaren is an Altmer scholar found in Ealaren's House in the city of Shimmerene, Summerset. She is hostile to the Vestige, and has no unique dialogue.
Earnaire is an Altmer noble found in Ealaren's House in the city of Shimmerene, Summerset. She is hostile to the Vestige, and has no unique dialogue.

Earl of Clavicus Vile is an Altmer found performing a Daedric ritual in the Monastery Undercroft in the city of Shimmerene, Summerset. He is later encountered in Coral Forest, where it is revealed that he is Aldarch Tilcalar.

Eamond Guimard was the King of Evermore, situated within the province of High Rock. Eamond Guimard was a noteworthy leader, known for his friendliness and strong-will, a contrast to the wildlands of the region of Bangkorai.
Dydier Genin is a Breton in Northern High Rock Gate, Cyrodiil in . He can be found patrolling the barricade.

Ebel Septim was the youngest legitimate son of Uriel Septim VII and Caula Voria. He was born in 3E 380 and grew up learning the arts of politics from his father. In 3E 433, at the age of 53, he was murdered by Mythic Dawn agents, along with his father and two brothers.

Eduard Denile was a Breton resident of Harlun's Watch. The town noticed some strange lights by Swampy Cave and sent a group to investigate. Unfortunately, the cave was inhabited by trolls, who quickly overwhelmed the civilians, killing them.

Eduard Retiene is a Breton living in the small settlement of Water's Edge with his wife Jolie. Their home is in the middle of the town. He wears lower class clothing and usually carries an Iron Mace and a small amount of gold.

Edwinna Elbert is a Breton mage found within the downstairs portion of the Ald'ruhn Mages Guild. She is also an exclaimed expert on the study of the Dwemer, and will task the Nerevarine in helping her with her own research; some of which include excavating several Dwemer ruins and retrieving various artifacts and books. Upon meeting her, Edwinna can notably be seen wearing a common robe, as well as a pair of expensive shoes. She is also equipped with a silver dagger and wields an ebony wizard's staff for protection. Edwinna also has a vast knowledge of spells, most of which are outlined below.
Edda is an Imperial beggar strolling in Riften. She is usually around the marketplace during the day asking for a Septim.

Edras Oril is a Dunmer found in the Ascadian Isles. He is a scholar and amateur naturalist, especially fascinated by kagoutis. Thus, he cannot resist to investigate a group of Mating Kagoutis while he was traveling with his friend Thoronor.
Edril Vules is a Dunmer Sorcerer who resides in Morrowind. He is located in the ruins of Bal Fell, with a group of Nords, and is a member of House Telvanni ("Lawman" rank).
Edward is a fictional character who appears in the King Edward book series.
Edla is a Skaal found in the Skaal Village. Until the quest "The Fate of the Skaal" has been completed, she is one of the villagers working on the temple around the Wind Stone.
Edrien Dencent is a deceased Breton residing south of Aldcroft, Glenumbra. He and his daughter live in a cottage beside the Aldcroft Lighthouse.
Edgar the Innkeeper is a deceased Breton found in the village of Westtry, High Rock.

Edrisi Telas is a Dunmer alchemist and a member of the Mages Guild residing in the city of Elden Root, Grahtwood. She is found at her stall in the Apothecarium, at the local branch, where she sells her wares.
Edgard Gane is a Breton residing in Crosswych, Glenumbra. He is found outside, near Marent Ergend and Menoit's Emporium.
Ebadnar is a Redguard residing in the Alik'r Camp, in Alcaire Castle. He is found resting in one of the tents in the camp.
Edwinna Gaering is a Breton banker, working in the Wayrest Treasury in Wayrest, Stormhaven.
Edrasa Drelas is a Dunmer found in Deepcrag Den. She is the wife of Boril Drelas, the owner of the kwama mine.
Eats-Spiders is a Khajiit weaponsmith of the Baandari Clan. He sells his wares at his stall, Spider-Bite Swords, at the Baandari Caravan found in Kozanset.
Eatzapa is an Argonian fence residing in the Evermore Outlaws Refuge.
Edryn Dravel is a Dunmer residing in the city of Kragenmoor.
Edheldor is a character residing in the Windcatcher Plantation in the region of Khenarthi's Roost.
Edwina is a Dunmer noble who resides in Hrogar's Hold in Stonefalls.
Edilitte Dantien is a character residing in the city of Wayrest.
Eats-Many-Hearts is an Argonian participating in the tournament at the Thizzrini Arena.
Eats-To-Learn is an Argonian found in Davon's Watch. She may be seen conversing with Runthor.
Edalor is a Bosmer hunter in who works at the Tall Trunk Tavern in Vulkwasten. He can be found on the second floor and has no unique dialogue.
Edweg is a retired knight of Arkay found near the Sanguine Barrows.
Eats-More-Gold is an Argonian worshipper of Sanguine found in Sanguine's Demesne.
Edhelorn, known as The Silvenar in-game, is a Bosmer located in Mistral. He is the first Silvenar in until his assassination, and is replaced by Indaenir after the quest "Striking at the Heart."
Echeteres are creatures that are native to Wrothgar. They can be found in many regions, though usually just in the plains and hills.
Edthas is a Bosmer residing in the city of Orsinium. He can be found in conversation with Minalcil, although he cannot be interacted with.
Echalettes are creatures that can be found in Wrothgar. They are a juvenile form of Echateres.
Edeonore Geontene is a character residing in the Hubalajad Palace in the city of Abah's Landing, Hew's Bane.
Eats-Loves-Kills is an Argonian leatherworker found offering his services in Anvil Ironworks and Tannery in Anvil, Gold Coast.
Ebrayd is a Redguard residing in Sentinel. He resides in the Forebearer's Forge.
Ebony is a cat residing at Teroni Serelnim's House in Ebonheart.
Eats-Aged-Meat is an Argonian member of the Undaunted. He is part of the expedition that got lost in the City of Ash II.
Edana Jemane is a Breton residing inside her house in Kvatch.
Edril Marethi is a Dunmer soldier and member of the Clockwork Apostles residing in the Brass Fortress, Clockwork City. He can be found standing guard inside the Clockwork Basilica.
Edeleg is a character residing in the Cloisters in the Brass Fortress, Clockwork City.
Eburris Calatus is an Imperial found within the Undercroft Great Hall of the Monastery of Serene Harmony in Shimmerene. He has no unique dialogue.
Edryno Giryon is a Dunmer residing in Vivec City, outside the Canton of St. Olms the Just.
Edrien Geornis is a Breton mage serving as the counselor to the Bloodfall Queen.
Eazei is an Argonian found at Stonewastes in Eazei's Hut in .

Eldafire is an Altmer Commoner who lives in the port of Seyda Neen. She has been troubled by a group of smugglers and is worried about their continued presence in a cave near Seyda Neen. She has a copy of the book "Notes on Racial Phylogeny" in her house.

Eldamil was an Altmer who led the Daedra army to Kvatch, but later repented his actions. He is primarily responsible for opening the Gate at Kvatch. He died during the Battle of Kvatch. He served as Mankar Camoran's chief lieutenant up until his death.
Ehlnofey, also known as the Earth Bones, are the faded descendants of the Aedra who walked on Nirn, as well as the ancestors of men and mer.
Elidor is an Altmer member of the Fighters Guild who is stranded with his comrades Rienna and Brag gro-Bharg in the Desolate Mine.
Eldrilu Dalen is a Dunmer priest living in Vos, Vvardenfell.
Eletta is a Redguard who helps new mages forge their staves upon entering the Arcane University.
Elante of Alinor is an Altmer scholar studying Daedric Shrines. She is equipped only with a silver dagger and upper-class clothing, but can also cast some spells to defend herself with.
Eitar is a Nord smith who resides in the city of Leyawiin. He assists Tun-Zeeus at The Dividing Line. Eitar is an apprentice-level trainer in the Armorer skill. He is married to Margarte.
Eiruki Hearth-Healer is a Nord barbarian who lives in Ebonheart. She is also a trooper of the Imperial Legion.

Elisa Pierrane is a Breton commoner whose husband Roderic is a fan of the Arena in the Imperial City. She makes frequent visits to Skingrad. Elisa and Roderic have a home in the Elven Gardens District in the Imperial City. She sleeps for 8 hours in the double bed upstairs in her home. She carries her house keys, a medium amount of gold, and wears middle class clothing.
Eigma is a Nord witch residing in Ald Daedroth. She is hostile to the Nerevarine.

Eimar is a Nord in who works at the Honningbrew Meadery in Whiterun, just outside of the city walls. When he is not working, he can be found in The Bannered Mare after the quest "Dampened Spirits" has started. His dream is to take over the business some day.
Elenwen is the Altmer First Emissary and Ambassador of the Thalmor in Skyrim, and resides in the Thalmor Embassy.

Elda Early-Dawn is a Nord living in Windhelm and is the owner of Candlehearth Hall. She rents beds for 10 and sells food. The Dragonborn can also find out the origin of the inn's name, Candlehearth Hall, by asking her. If anything happens to her, Nils will take over the running of the inn.
Eisa Blackthorn is a Nord bandit located outside Frostmere Crypt.
Elam Andas is a Dunmer Crusader and member of the Tribunal Temple, who resides in the Vivec, Temple Canton within the Office of the Watch.
Eldil Bradyn is a Dunmer Rogue who is imprisoned at Buckmoth Legion Fort in Morrowind.

Eldrar Fathyron is a Dunmer who resides in Morrowind. Eldrar is an oathman of House Telvanni and can be found in the city of Vivec. He also carries a key that opens a cell holding a group of Argonian and Khajiit slaves held in the Telvanni Canalworks.
Eldrasea Helas is a hostile Dunmer sorcerer residing in Punabi.
Elethus Tobor is a Dunmer rogue who resides in the Vivec, St. Delyn Canton on the Ascadian Isles on Vvardenfell, Morrowind.
Elibael Puntumisun is a Dunmer who resides in the Grazelands Morrowind.

Elitlaya Assonirishpal is a Dunmer Mabrigash who resides in the West Gash region of Vvardenfell. She resides at a bonfire camp on a little hill northeast and next to Berandas. She, along with her partners, Hinummu Siddurnanit and Hansi Saharnatturapli will attack the Nerevarine on sight, unless a charm spell is cast, followed by raising their dispositions.
Elms Llervu is a Dunmer savant and member of House Redoran who resides in the Vivec, Redoran Canton. Elms is also a skill trainer in Mercantile and Speechcraft as well as Athletics.
Eindel is a Bosmer residing in Llethri Manor in Ald'ruhn's Manor District. She is a member of House Redoran.
Jarl Elgryr the Unminded served as Jarl of Windhelm sometime during the Second Era.
Elegnan is a Bosmer who resides in Tel Mora. She owns and operates the shop known as Elegnan: Clothier, where she sells clothes.
Ekapi is a Khajiit slave in Panat. She is enslaved alongside Ula and Tsabhi. They can be freed with the Panat Slave Key carried by Dravil Omavel.
Elder Othreloth is a Dunmer priest and keeper of the temple in Raven Rock. He resides in the temple with his apprentice Galdrus Hlervu.

Effe-Tei is an Argonian mage who resides in the reception area of the Royal Palace in Mournhold. He offers transportation back to the isle of Vvardenfell and provides introductory information about Mournhold.
Elbert Nermarc is a Breton enchanter who resides at the Craftsmen's Hall in Godsreach in the city of Mournhold.
Eleedal-Lei is an Argonian Slave working for Therana in the Abebaal Egg Mine. He is currently the leader of a slave uprising.
Elegal is a Bosmer merchant found in Sadrith Mora on the island of Vvardenfell.
Eiman is a Nord found imprisoned by the The Frozen Man inside Orkey's Hollow. His sister, Rolunda, is desperately looking for him.

Elethien is a Bosmer first met in the Screaming Mermaid, after the quest "Innocent Scoundrel." residing in Port Hunding, Stros M'Kai, standing among other Jakarn's admirers. She has been involved with Jakarn, and along with Irien and Nasmat, they want him to make up his mind when all meet on the ship back to Daggerfall. She later appears at the inns in Wayrest and Sentinel. In Wayrest she tells the Vestige she's done with sailing.
Elaraama is an Altmer ghost in found in the Temple of Mourning Springs after the quest "Tears of the Two Moons" has been completed, and once the ghosts have returned to the temple.
Elante is an Altmer sorceress who resides in the cave of Ibar-Dad. She is hostile, so she will attack the Nerevarine on sight.
Eirdre Mavine is a Breton who resides in the city of Daggerfall. She can be found outside the blacksmith forge being smitten of the men working.
Ella Miller is a Breton who resides in Deleyn's Mill in Glenumbra. She is married to Morric Miller.
El-Lurasha is an Argonian slave who resides in the Telvanni Canton in Vivec City.
Elarie is an Altmer weaponsmith who resides in Port Hunding. She has a shop in the marketplace selling weapons and offers repairs. Next to her stall is that of the blacksmith Yncien Falbert.
Eilina is a Redguard magus in Daggerfall Mages Guild. She can assist the Vestige when they are looking for a specific book. She also has a variety of goods for sale.
Ellashana is an Redguard located first on the island of Stros M'Kai, and then Betnikh. She is part of Kaleens crew and follows Neramo to the ruin of Dwemer ruin of Bthzark and then Moriseli.
Elamusa is a Khajiit alchemist residing in the city of Aldcroft, Glenumbra. She sells her wares at her stall, Elamusa's Marvelous Elixirs, at the Dockside Green.
Elaldor is a Bosmer hunter residing in Woodhearth in the region of Greenshade.
Eghanar the Iron-Minder is a Bosmer armorer residing in Redfur Trading Post, Grahtwood. He can be found at his stall, The Iron Warden, selling his wares.
Eight-Feather-Tail is an Argonian drunkard residing in Koeglin Village, Stormhaven. She is staying at the Sleepy Sailor Inn, drinking and waiting for work.
Elendare is an Altmer armorer residing in the city of Vulkhel Guard, Auridon. She can be found at her store, Aegis of Auri-El, selling her wares.
Eifid is a Nord barbarian and member of the false Skaal tribe on Solstheim. He can be found inside the Raven Rock Mine.

Eglar Thundren is a character who appears in . Despite being the holder of one of the Shadowkeys, nothing else is explained or known about him, though he is found in the room next to Yelnicin, the leader of the Gold Raiders. He appears in the south of Raider's Nest.
Egilas is a Bosmer residing in Mistral. He can be seen attempting to catch fish, nearby his father, Egenor.
Elannie is an Altmer residing in the city of Dawnbreak, in Auridon.
Ejukki is a Khajiit mage, and member of the Mages Guild. She is part of Telenger the Artificer's expedition taking place at Ezduiin.
Elenya is an Altmer found in the Ezduiin Undercroft in Auridon, and are a member of the Mages Guild.

Elengil is a Bosmer commoner living in Bramblebreach. According to Doriel, who looks after her, she is the oldest living member of the tribe. Her grandmother belonged to the very tribe that first moved into the Court of the Wilderking. Upon her grandmother's death the still very young Elengil remembers seeing a glimpse of the Wilderking himself mourning over the loss of the last member of the original tribe.
Eilenda the Caller is a Nord member of the Mages Guild. She is found at their guildhall in Mournhold.
Egrien Stout is a merchant in . He can be found in Stout's Trading Post. He will lower his prices once Broken Wing Cameo is completed.
Eldwen is an Altmer member of the Mages Guild and one of Telenger the Artificer's apprentices. She is found at his emporium in Skywatch.
Elder Seven-Bellies is an Argonian residing in the village of Lukiul Uxith, Stonefalls.
Ehlimah af-Hisham is a Redguard residing in the city of Sentinel.
Egeria is an Imperial chef working at the Crossroads Tavern in Belkarth.
Egeria Clodianus is an Imperial member of the Fighters Guild. She is found at their branch in Velyn Harbor.
Eginir Thistlebreeches is a Bosmer found at the Thulvald's Logging Camp.
Eginthorili is a Bosmer member of the Shadow Walkers clan who can be found in The Moonless Walk.
Egolor was a Bosmer gambler who was murdered at the Thizzrini Arena.
Egranor is a Bosmer member of the Vinedusk Rangers tracking down remaining members of the Veiled Heritance hiding in the vicinity of Skywatch.
Ehteram is a Redguard part of a caravan that was attacked by Giant Snakes while on her way toward Bangkorai.
Eil at-Amil is a follower of Sanguine found in the ruins of Sanguine's Demesne.
Eimander is a Nord member of the Stormfist Clan found in Fort Morvunskar.
Eirfa is a Nord participating in the drinking contest at Geirmund's Hall.
Eislef Frostmoon was a Nord living at his family's farmstead just outside Riften. Like most of his family, he was murdered by an unknown assailant.

Elandora is a Bosmer found east of the Ilayas Ruins. She is in charge of The Dancing Scrib, a group of traveling entertainers which has been captured by a group of local bandits known as the Steel Shrikes.
Elanecarne is an Altmer mystic and member of the Mages Guild residing in Shinji's Scarp, Stormhaven. She can be found at the local branch, selling her wares.
Elantelle is an Altmer member of Queen Ayrenn's entourage found just outside the ruins of Tanzelwil.
Elarie Two-Spoons is an Altmer chef who works at the Phynaster's Stride, in the city of Haven, Grahtwood.
Elder Elsaril is a Bosmer residing at The Moonless Walk in Coldharbour. She is one of the four leaders of the Shadow Walkers clan.
Elder Erthor is one of the four leaders of the Shadow Walkers clan found at The Moonless Walk.
Elder Gluin is one of the four leaders of the Shadow Walkers clan found at The Moonless Walk.
Elder Inril is one of the four leaders of the Shadow Walkers clan found at The Moonless Walk.
Eldumoril is an Altmer brewer residing in Marbruk in . He can be found at The Parchment & Horn, selling his wares.
Eldyme is a Altmer fence residing in the outlaws refuge in Mournhold, Deshaan.
Elenabi is a Khajiit fisherwoman found on the western shores of Khenarthi's Roost.
Elendarie is an Altmer soldier of the Aldmeri Dominion in who is posted in Firsthold. She later escorts Queen Ayrenn to Hectahame in Greenshade.
Elerdel is a Bosmer who resides in Vulkwasten, in the region of Malabal Tor.
Elfriede is a Nord warrior seeking The Shards of Wuuthrad in Honrich Tower.
Eliana Barbatus is an Imperial in who guards the captured Imperial Legionaries in Cheydinhal.

Eliana Salvius is an Imperial guard of a Temple of Mara. Her and her fellow guards Decanus Vulso and Veranus Macatus followed the bandits into their lair at Fort Sphinxmoth. Once inside, they were no match for the sheer number of bandits and were captured.
Elikar Lloderion is a soldier of the Aldmeri Dominion part of the invading force that took over Farwatch Tower.
Elise is a Breton member of the Lion Guard who has lost her way in the Bonesnap Ruins.
Ellisif is a Nord enchanter of the Ebonheart Pact. She sells her wares at Shadutsei's Emporium at the Southern Morrowind Gate.
Ehshaz is a Redguard member of the Fighters Guild residing in the city of Orsinium.
Elam Drals is a Dunmer assassin in who resides in the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary. He handles the more day-to-day contracts assigned to the Dark Brotherhood. Later on he reappears in DLC.
Elarril is a Altmer residing in the Weynon Priory in Chorrol, Cyrodiil.
Egidnor is a Bosmer who can be found in Deepwoods, Malabal Tor.
Eldecil is an Altmer member of the Thalmor. He is encountered within the Imperial Underground, located underneath Woodhearth.
Eleril is an Altmer member of the Mages Guild. He is part of the expedition taking place at the Ossuary of Telacar.
Eleedal-Kia is an Argonian commoner residing at Licks-Longfins's House in Ebonheart.
Elgenie Dubroc is a Breton laborer residing in Anvil. She can be found working on the docks. She cannot be interacted with.
Elemra Llandu is a Dunmer working at the City Center of Mournhold.
Eiola Windstrider is a Bosmer found at the Dragonstar Arena.

Eldfyr is a Nord found in Riften. He is one of the many targets granted by the Litany of Blood. He can be found wandering around town and sometimes in the Riften Fighters Guild. He will stop to listen to Anriel playing music in front of the well in the marketplace.
Elden Root Guards are generic Bosmer guards who patrol the city of Elden Root, Grahtwood.
Eistaag is a Nord hired as a guard at the Fulstrom Homestead.
Elite Dres Charger is a generic Thundermaul residing in locations in .
Eldergleam Matron is a creature card in that is a part of the Heroes of Skyrim expansion.
Eerika Skjoralmor is a Nord who is the Thane of Falkreath Hold, and is leading the defense of the city from the Dreadhorn Clan. She is the daughter of Hjurgol Skjoralmor, the Jarl of the Hold.
Eldrasea Deras is a Dunmer found in front of the Clockwork Crossroads Wayshrine in the Clockwork City.
Elhul Sathil was a Dunmer member of House Sathil. He was the son of Hleryn Sathil.
Eld Ma is a gnarled old woman who works as a servant in Sathil castle.
Egren was an Umbrielian working in Phmer's kitchen. He was one of Phmer's underchefs.
Eliras is a character in and a member of the Dark Brotherhood. It is unknown if he was killed or not.
Eldinaran is an Altmer found with her companion Guz at their camp in Rivenspire at one of their possible locations. The Vestige can light their fire as part of the Lightbringer achievement.

Elianne Alfena is an Imperial noble found outside of the hedge maze in the city of Shimmerene, Summerset. She is sitting with Lairiwene and Quorarion, and is being served by Snabugha, but will occasionally walk into the maze's northern corner.
Elivette Dupare is a Breton found within the Undercroft Great Hall of the Monastery of Serene Harmony in Shimmerene. She has no unique dialogue.

Elder Azulg is an Orsimer elder of the Vosh Rakh located in Paragon's Remembrance, found exclusively during the events of "The Anger of a King", in the Chambers of Loyalty. He guards the scrolls and advises the new recruits on their uses.
Elder Uznom is an Orsimer elder of the Vosh Rakh who is found in Paragon's Remembrance, exclusively during the events of "The Anger of a King."
Eilelmil is an Altmer who can be found in a vanguard camp near Sea Keep in Summerset. She cannot be interacted with.
Egg-Tender Meena is an Argonian of the Bright-Throat Tribe who tends the "uxith" or nest where the eggs are cared for in the Bright-Throat Village.
Elazura is a Khajiit who appears throughout various settlements talking to Naraku in Northern Elsweyr.
Elasarha is a character in . She is an author for Blood-Soaked Letter that is found during "A Smuggler's Last Stand" quest.

The Elder Gods are an obscure group of deities that the people of Tamriel were aware of during the Imperial Simulacrum, from 3E 389 to 3E 399. According to rumors at the time, they would one day come to Tamriel and make Black Marsh "burn for its sins."
Elone is a Redguard scout and a journeyman in the Blades. Elone has a room in Arrille's Tradehouse and spends most of her time there.

Elysana is the Breton daughter of the now-deceased Queen Carolyna and King Eadwyre of Wayrest, born in 3E 389. She is also the step daughter of Barenziah, and step sister of King Helseth and Queen Morgiah of Firsthold. She was betrothed to Lord Woodborne, however, he was killed by The Agent.
Emelia Duronia is an Imperial Guild Guide and a member of the Mages Guild in Caldera. She serves as the Guild Guide for this Guild hall.
Elvas Savel is a Dunmer drillmaster who resides in Molag Mar, Morrowind. He offers melee training at the Redoran Stronghold located atop the city, but is not a member of the House.
Elvil Vidron is a Dunmer Commoner who lives in Suran and believes himself to be the Nerevarine.
Elynu Saren is a Dunmer priest who is located at the Tribunal Temple in Suran. She sells books, potions, spells, and offers spellmaking.
Else God-Hater is a Nord who lives at the West Weald Inn in Skingrad. She is strongly antipathetic towards worship of the Nine Divines.
Emfrid is a Nord and the proprietor of the The Grey Mare inn in Chorrol. Emfird buys and sells food but not drinks, and has 50 to bargain with. A bed is available for 10 a night.
Elragail is a Bosmer who lives in the Imperial City. She watches over and lives with her friend Thamriel, who is believed to have been 'touched' by the gods in the Talos Plaza District.
Eloe is an Imperial Bard residing in Galom Daeus. She is a minion of the Berne vampire clan.
Embry is a Nord drunkard found in the Sleeping Giant Inn and around town in Riverwood.
Elrindir is a Bosmer merchant in who owns The Drunken Huntsman in Whiterun with his brother Anoriath.
Elumabi Maliiran is a Dunmer Mabrigash who resides in the West Gash region of Vvardenfell in a small camp. She is hostile and will attack the Nerevarine on sight.
Elynea Norvayn is a Dunmer who resides outside the Caldera Mine.
Emelin is a Bosmer enforcer and a member of House Telvanni residing in Tel Mora.
Elphiron is a Bosmer warrior who resides in the Upper Tower of Tel Mora. She is a member of House Telvanni.
Eloroth is a Bosmer who resides in the Vivec, Hlaalu Canton. He is a member of House Hlaalu.
The Elytra Matron is a creature in . It is the most powerful form of Elytra.
Elynea Mothren is a Dunmer alchemist living on Solstheim. She runs the Tel Mithryn Apothecary and serves as Neloth's mycologist.
Elphaniel is a Bosmer bard residing in Port Hunding. She can be found upstairs in the Screaming Mermaid, entertaining the crowds.
Elwilinta is an Altmer residing in Elden Root in the region of Grahtwood.
Emecelmo is an Altmer residing in Elden Root in the region of Grahtwood.
Elodie Castille is a Breton who is found in the Wyrd camp near Tangle Rock in Glenumbra. She is a refugee from Camlorn.
Elondil is an Altmer residing in the city of Elden Root, Grahtwood.
Emabeth Gestor is a Breton residing in Crosswych, Glenumbra. Her son Vincein runs the family business, while she is upstairs cleaning.°
Elsenia is a Bosmer vampire from Longhaven, and wife of Thorinor. She can be found in Shademist Moors.

Elondore is an Altmer residing in the city of Marbruk in the region of Greenshade, Valenwood. She admires young Aranias who is determined to investigate in the local Bosmer's worhsip of a god they call the "Wilderking."
Embassy Sentry is an Altmer residing in the city of Silvenar.
Emmandic Oltz is a Breton member of the Mages Guild residing on the island of Eyevea.
Elonde is an Altmer who resides in the city of Rawl'kha, Reaper's March. He is typically found at The Waxing Crescent inn.
Elphiniel is a member of the Fighters Guild in who resides in the hall of Vulkwasten.
Elruin is a Bosmer in who works at the Tall Trunk Tavern in Vulkwasten.
Elseer Vayn is a Bosmer Merchant found at the Trader's Rest.
Eluzard is a Khajiit found at the Temple of Two-Moons Dance.
Emahd is a refugee from the town of Hackdirt found at the Refugee Camp in Cyrodiil.
Emanir is a Bosmer provisioner found in Bramblebreach. She spends most of her time in her house.
Emeraude Oresme is a Breton healer tending to wounded members of the Shornhelm City Guard at Oldgate.
